mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(p.permission, legacy.permission) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.available = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_data_permission_data p ON p.biz_id = ur.role_id AND p.biz_type = 0 AND p.permission_type = #{permissionType} LEFT JOIN sys_data_permission_data legacy ON legacy.biz_id = ur.role_id AND legacy.biz_type = 0 AND legacy.permission_type = 100 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND (p.id IS NOT NULL OR legacy.id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_purchase_order${isForm ? "_form" : ""} o WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_sale_order o WHERE o.id = #{id}
